raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#34038 moved the ragged-verify tier resolution into `DSparkVerifyPlanner._resolve_verify_tier`, which calls `round_up_grid` on the token floor. `schedule_layout` now calls that helper before its `ragged_layout_exceeds_captured_grid` check, so when the floor is above `capture_num_tokens[-1]`, `round_up_grid` raises `ValueError` and kills the scheduler instead of falling back to eager.

This happens in COMPACT ragged verify with confidence scheduling (not verify-all) whenever a decode batch is larger than the captured CUDA-graph grid, for example `--max-running-requests` > `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode`. Before #34038 the exceeds check ran first and returned `None` (eager).

```
File ".../dspark_planner.py", line 432, in schedule_layout
File ".../dspark_planner.py", line 533, in _resolve_verify_tier
File ".../ragged_verify.py", line 38, in round_up_grid
ValueError: total 255 exceeds max grid tier 32; the caller must reject this batch before selecting a graph tier
```

## Modifications

- `_resolve_verify_tier` runs `ragged_layout_exceeds_captured_grid` itself and returns `exceeds_captured_grid`. When the tier exceeds the grid, it skips `round_up_grid` and returns `graph_num_tokens=None`.
- `schedule_layout` returns `None` (eager) on `tier.exceeds_captured_grid`, so the exceeds check and the rounding share one source.
- `_budget_aligned_to_graph_tier` already returns the budget unchanged when `graph_num_tokens is None`, so with `speculative_dspark_align_verify_tokens_to_graph_tier` on, oversized batches no longer raise there either.
- Added CPU unit tests in `test_dspark_scheduler.py`: tier resolution past the grid (no hint and DP tier hint), `schedule_layout` falling back to eager, and the aligned budget staying unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Not affected: the change only turns a crash into the eager fallback that existed before #34038.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

N/A.

## Verification (1x B300)

- Unit tests, `test/registered/spec/dspark/test_dspark_scheduler.py`: this PR 20 passed; `main` planner 3 of the new tests fail with the `ValueError` above.
- End to end: Qwen/Qwen3-14B + `deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_14b_block7`, `SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=compact`, an initialized SPS table (`--speculative-dspark-sps-table-path`), `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 4 --max-running-requests 32`, 32 concurrent requests of 256 tokens.
  - `main`: the scheduler crashes with the `ValueError` above; 0/32 requests complete.
  - This PR: 32/32 requests complete (8192 tokens); decode at bs=32 runs eager (`cuda graph: False`), accept len 3.54.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

+        if tier.exceeds_captured_grid:
             return None

@@ -528,16 +525,25 @@ def _resolve_verify_tier(
             model_runner=self.model_runner,
             tier_num_tokens=tier_num_tokens,
         )
+        exceeds_captured_grid = ragged_layout_exceeds_captured_grid(
+            num_reqs=tier_num_reqs,
+            verify_num_draft_tokens=self.verify_num_draft_tokens,
+            model_runner=self.model_runner,
+            tier_tokens_hint=tier_num_tokens,
+        )
         capture_num_tokens = ragged_capture_num_tokens(model_runner=self.model_runner)
         graph_num_tokens = (
             round_up_grid(graph_num_tokens_floor, capture_num_tokens)

         )

             tier_num_reqs=tier_num_reqs,
             tier_num_tokens=tier_num_tokens,
             graph_num_tokens_floor=graph_num_tokens_floor,

             graph_num_tokens=graph_num_tokens,
         )

@@ -411,6 +411,25 @@ def _fake_model_runner(capture_num_tokens, max_bs):
     return types.SimpleNamespace(decode_cuda_graph_runner=runner)
 
 
+def _fake_compact_planner(
+    *, capture_num_tokens, max_bs, verify_num_draft_tokens, align=False
+):
+    from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_planner import (
+        DSparkVerifyPlanner,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.speculative.ragged_verify import RaggedVerifyMode
+
+    planner = DSparkVerifyPlanner.__new__(DSparkVerifyPlanner)
+    planner.model_runner = _fake_model_runner(capture_num_tokens, max_bs=max_bs)
+    planner.verify_num_draft_tokens = verify_num_draft_tokens
+    planner._ragged_verify_mode = RaggedVerifyMode.COMPACT
+    planner._schedule_cfg = DSparkScheduleConfig(gamma=verify_num_draft_tokens - 1)
+    planner._dynamic_graph_tier = False
+    planner._is_verify_all = False
+    planner._align_verify_tokens_to_graph_tier = align
+    return planner
+
+
 class TestBudgetTierSelection(CustomTestCase):
     def test_floor_uses_tier_hint_capped_at_uniform_window(self):
         from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_planner import (
@@ -480,6 +499,56 @@ def test_exceeds_gate_checks_slots_and_tier(self):
             )
         )
 
+    def test_resolve_tier_past_captured_grid_skips_round_up(self):
+        planner = _fake_compact_planner(
+            capture_num_tokens=[8, 16, 1024], max_bs=256, verify_num_draft_tokens=8
+        )
+        tier = planner._resolve_verify_tier(
+            num_reqs=200, global_num_reqs=None, dp_tier_num_tokens=None, budget=None
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(tier.exceeds_captured_grid)
+        self.assertIsNone(tier.graph_num_tokens)
+        tier = planner._resolve_verify_tier(
+            num_reqs=100, global_num_reqs=200, dp_tier_num_tokens=1100, budget=None
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(tier.exceeds_captured_grid)
+        self.assertIsNone(tier.graph_num_tokens)
+        tier = planner._resolve_verify_tier(
+            num_reqs=4, global_num_reqs=None, dp_tier_num_tokens=None, budget=None
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(tier.exceeds_captured_grid)
+        self.assertEqual(tier.graph_num_tokens, 1024)
+
+    def test_schedule_layout_past_captured_grid_falls_back_to_eager(self):
+        planner = _fake_compact_planner(
+            capture_num_tokens=[8, 16, 1024], max_bs=256, verify_num_draft_tokens=8
+        )
+        bs = 200
+        planner._schedule_verify_lens = lambda **_: torch.ones(bs, dtype=torch.int32)
+        layout = planner.schedule_layout(
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(bs),
+            prefix_lens=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.int64),
+            device=torch.device("cpu"),
+            confidence=None,
+            budget=None,
+        )
+        self.assertIsNone(layout)
+
+    def test_aligned_budget_past_captured_grid_is_unchanged(self):
+        planner = _fake_compact_planner(
+            capture_num_tokens=[8, 16, 1024],
+            max_bs=256,
+            verify_num_draft_tokens=8,
+            align=True,
+        )
+        budget = planner._budget_aligned_to_graph_tier(
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(200),
+            budget=300,
+            global_num_reqs=None,
+            dp_tier_num_tokens=None,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(budget, 300)
